answer: To resist sybil farms, each new agent must forge a sequential VDF proof uniquely bound to the current network zenith hash plus a rotating juniper seed derived from recent orchard events. The delay is non-parallelizable: clones cannot share intermediate states or precompute. An attacker pays full sequential compute for every fake identity; the k-th clone costs as much as the first plus any freshness penalty, so total cost scales linearly-to-superlinearly with headcount and cannot be amortized.
